name: unsafe fn shrink (& self , ptr : NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : Layout , new_layout : Layout ,) -> Result < NonNull < [u8] > , AllocError >
rule: For safety, ptr must denote a memory block currently allocated via this allocator: its starting address must have been returned by allocate, grow, or shrink on this allocator, and it must not subsequently have been deallocated by deallocate or by a successful grow or shrink. A grow or shrink returning Err does not deallocate the block.
api: trait Allocator  : { unsafe fn shrink (& self , ptr : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout , new_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout ,) -> core::result::Result < core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < [u8] > , core::alloc::AllocError > }
